title: RigorQuant literature known-results.json
description: The verified literature map, keyed by sub-problem id (SPn). Entries are settled/impossible/superseded/open; verified state lives ONLY here, never in interim dossiers (a dossier is advisory evidence, not a verified record).

category.description: settled = proven true; impossible = proven false/intractable (a verified negative); superseded = stale; open = neither settled nor impossible

negative_export.description: true when this impossible entry was exported to the off-grid lane as a provenance-stripped constraint

escalation.description: study-root-relative path to the math-lane record that accepted this impossibility (architecture.md Decision 14: a negative the conclusion RESTS on is load-bearing). Required before a sub-problem may be routed away as impossible: the literature lane certifies that the literature says X, never that X is true.

paper_id.description: canonical identifier: arXiv:XXXX.XXXXX, DOI:10.x/..., or a normalized title

status.description: only verified-current counts as a verified record; unverifiable (abstract-only) is a lower confidence tier and never load-bearing

evidence.description: study-root-relative path to the lit-adversary's per-claim verdict
